info.title: dotgit
info.description: Git repository toolkit: clone and update many repositories at once.

commands.name: clone
commands.description: Clone a Git repository to a specified destination

options.name: --destination-path
options.description: Local path where the repository will be cloned [Required]

options.name: --repository-list
options.description: List file containing repositories to clone, one line for repository [Required]

options.name: --repository-url
options.description: URL of the Git repository to clone, fallback to env GIT_URL_DEFAULT. Example: git@ssh.dev.azure.com:v3/MyOrg/MyProject

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Maximum seconds to wait for cloning each repository. [Default: 60]

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update all Git repositories found in the specified path

options.name: --path
options.description: Path to search for Git repositories. Default: current directory [Default: @"."]

options.name: --branches
options.description: Target branches to switch to (in order of priority). Default: develop, main, master.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the remote of each repository. [Default: 60]
